dashboard.titulo: 1502 - PRODUTOS DE TERCEIROS EM NOSSO PODER
dashboard.descricao: Este dashboard realiza a auditoria do estoque em poder de terceiros, confrontando as quantidades enviadas e retornadas para apurar o saldo atual por lote e validade.

grid.expression: SELECT CABNFS.NUNOTA AS "NumeroUnico", CABNFS.NUMNOTA AS "NumeroNota", CABNFS.VLRNOTA AS "ValorNFe", SANKHYA.SNK_FORMAT_DATE(CABNFS.AD_DTCIRURG,'DD/MM/YYYY') AS "DataCirurgia", CABNFS.AD_PACIENTE AS "NomePaciente", PAR.CODPARC AS "CodParceiro", PAR.NOMEPARC AS "DescrParcEstoque", ENDP.TIPO AS TPEND , ENDP.NOMEEND AS ENDERECO, PAR.NUMEND AS NUMEND, BAIP.NOMEBAI AS BAIRRO, CIDP.NOMECID AS CIDADE, UFSP.UF AS UF, SANKHYA.FC_FORMATACEP(PAR.CEP) AS CEP, PRO.CODPROD AS "CodProduto", PRO.DESCRPROD AS "DescricaoProduto", PRO.MARCA AS "Marca", PRO.REFFORN AS "COdCatalogo", EST.CONTROLE AS "Lote", SANKHYA.SNK_FORMAT_DATE(EST.DTVAL,'DD/MM/YYYY') AS "DataValidade", SANKHYA.SNK_FORMAT_DATE(CABNFS.DTNEG,'DD/MM/YYYY') AS "DataNegociacao", SANKHYA.SNK_DATE_DIFF(GETDATE(),CABNFS.DTNEG) AS "Tempo", PRO.CODVOL AS "Unidade", ISNULL(ITENFS.QTDNEG,0) AS "QtdEnviada", ISNULL(ITED.QTDNEG,0) AS "QtdRetornada", (ISNULL(ITENFS.QTDNEG,0) - ISNULL(ITED.QTDNEG,0)) AS "Saldo", CONS.QTDE AS "QtdConsigadoFixo", CASE WHEN (ISNULL(ITENFS.QTDNEG,0) - ISNULL(ITED.QTDNEG,0)) < ISNULL(CONS.QTDE ,0) THEN '#FF0000' -- WHEN ISNULL((SELECT SUM(ESTOQUE-RESERVADO) FROM TGFEST WHERE CODPROD = ItemNota.CODPROD AND CODEMP = CabecalhoNota.CODEMP),0) < (ItemNota.QTDNEG-ItemNota.QTDENTREGUE) THEN '#FFFF00' ELSE '' END AS BKCOLOR, CASE WHEN (ISNULL(ITENFS.QTDNEG,0) - ISNULL(ITED.QTDNEG,0)) < ISNULL(CONS.QTDE ,0) THEN '#FFFFFF' -- WHEN ISNULL((SELECT SUM(ESTOQUE-RESERVADO) FROM TGFEST WHERE CODPROD = ItemNota.CODPROD AND CODEMP = CabecalhoNota.CODEMP),0) < (ItemNota.QTDNEG-ItemNota.QTDENTREGUE) THEN '#FFFF00' ELSE '' END AS FGCOLOR FROM TGFCAB AS CABNFS INNER JOIN SANKHYA.TGFITE AS ITENFS ON ITENFS.NUNOTA = CABNFS.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFTOP AS TOP1 ON TOP1.CODTIPOPER = CABNFS.CODTIPOPER AND TOP1.DHALTER = CABNFS.DHTIPOPER INNER JOIN SANKHYA.TGFEST AS EST ON EST.CODEMP = ITENFS.CODEMP AND EST.CODPROD = ITENFS.CODPROD AND EST.CODLOCAL = ITENFS.CODLOCALORIG AND EST.CONTROLE = ITENFS.CONTROLE AND EST.CODPARC = CABNFS.CODPARC AND EST.TIPO = TOP1.ATUALESTTERC INNER JOIN TGFPAR AS PAR ON CABNFS.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC LEFT JOIN SANKHYA.TSIEND AS ENDP ON ENDP.CODEND = PAR.CODEND LEFT JOIN SANKHYA.TSIBAI AS BAIP ON BAIP.CODBAI = PAR.CODBAI LEFT JOIN SANKHYA.TSICID AS CIDP ON CIDP.CODCID = PAR.CODCID LEFT JOIN SANKHYA.TSIUFS AS UFSP ON UFSP.CODUF = CIDP.UF INNER JOIN TGFPRO AS PRO ON ITENFS.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD LEFT JOIN TGFVAR VAR ON VAR.NUNOTAORIG = CABNFS.NUNOTA AND VAR.SEQUENCIAORIG = ITENFS.SEQUENCIA LEFT JOIN TGFCAB CABD ON CABD.NUNOTA = VAR.NUNOTA AND CABD.TIPMOV IN('C','E') LEFT JOIN TGFITE ITED ON ITED.NUNOTA = CABD.NUNOTA AND ITED.SEQUENCIA = VAR.SEQUENCIA LEFT JOIN TGFTOP TOPD ON TOPD.CODTIPOPER = CABD.CODTIPOPER AND TOPD.DHALTER = CABD.DHTIPOPER AND TOPD.ATUALESTTERC = 'D' LEFT JOIN AD_CONSFIXO CONS ON CONS.CODPARC = CABNFS.CODPARC AND CONS.CODPROD = ITENFS.CODPROD WHERE ((ISNULL (EST.ESTOQUE, 0) <> 00) AND (EST.CODPARC <> 0) AND (EST.TIPO = 'T') AND (TOP1.ATUALESTTERC = 'T') AND (CABNFS.TIPMOV = 'C') AND ISNULL(ITENFS.QTDNEG,0) - ISNULL(ITED.QTDNEG,0) > 0 ) AND (CabNFS.DTNEG >= :p_dtnegini.INI) AND (CabNFS.DTNEG <= :p_dtnegini.FIN) AND CABNFS.CODPARC BETWEEN :p_parini AND :p_parfin AND ITENFS.CODPROD BETWEEN :p_prodini AND :p_prodfin -- Inserção do parâmetro de validade AND (EST.DTVAL >= :P_DTVAL.INI OR :P_DTVAL.INI IS NULL) AND (EST.DTVAL <= :P_DTVAL.FIN OR :P_DTVAL.FIN IS NULL)
